proposals.before: The section on ecliptic lodge passage was supplemented by Wu Ze and others of the Astronomical Bureau; the versions of Wu Shiju of Kaifeng, Cheng Xi of the National University, and Zhang Wenjin of Changzhou all lack it.
proposals.after: The ecliptic lodge-passage section was supplemented and corrected by Wu Ze and others of the Astronomical Bureau; the versions of Wu Shiju, Presented Scholar of Kaifeng, Cheng Xi, Presented Scholar of the National University, and Zhang Wenjin, commoner of Changzhou, all lack it.
proposals.reason: Chinese 補治 means supplement and correct, and 開封進士/國學進士/常州百姓 are credentials/status titles attached to the names, not mere place of-phrases.

proposals.before: At conjunction, if it is not a true crossing, the sun lies on the ecliptic and the moon on the nine paths at the lodges entered—though the amounts differ.
proposals.after: At conjunction, if it is not a true crossing, the sun lies on the ecliptic and the moon on the nine paths at the lodges entered.
proposals.reason: Chinese s0281 ends at 所入宿度; 雖多少不同 belongs to the next sentence (s0282) and was incorrectly fused into this unit.

proposals.before: Whenever at conjunction, if it is not a true crossing, the sun is on the Yellow Path and the moon on the nine paths, at the lodges entered—though the amounts differ.
proposals.after: Whenever at conjunction, if it is not a true crossing, the sun is on the Yellow Path and the moon on the nine paths, at the lodges entered.
proposals.reason: Chinese s0281 ends at 所入宿度; 雖多少不同 belongs to the next sentence (s0282) and was incorrectly fused into this unit.

decisions.reason: 補治 requires both supplement and correct, and 開封進士、國學進士、常州百姓 mark credential/status, not bare place-of phrases; the proposed wording restores those senses without inventing content.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 太史局吳澤等補治有此一段，開封進士吳時舉、國學進士程憙、常州百姓張文進本並無之

decisions.reason: s0281 ends at 所入宿度; 雖多少不同 opens s0282, so the fused clause “though the amounts differ” does not belong in this unit.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 凡合朔加時，若非正交，即日在黃道、月在九道所入宿度。

decisions.reason: The Chinese unit stops at 所入宿度; 雖多少不同 is the start of s0282, so removing the fused clause from the literal is required.
